title: Mediterranean Steak
description: Scotch fillet in a rich cream sauce with king prawns and green peppercorns. Surf and turf done properly — the bistro way.

ingredients.notes: Don't add too much all at once — you can't take it out once it's in.

method.instruction: Grill or pan-fry scotch fillets over high heat to desired doneness. Remove and rest on a warm plate.
Melt butter in the same pan over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 2–3 minutes.
Add prawns and cook for 1–2 minutes until just pink — they will finish in the sauce.
Deglaze the pan with brandy. Let it reduce by half, about 1 minute.
Add demi glace and thickened cream. Stir and reduce for 2–3 minutes until the sauce is rich and coats the back of a spoon.
Add green peppercorns and stir through. Season with salt.
Plate the steak, arrange prawns around and over, and spoon the sauce generously over everything.

notes.title: Prawn Timing
notes.content: Prawns finish cooking in the sauce — do not overcook them in the initial sear or they will become tough. Brandy is the correct alcohol for the deglaze, giving a warmer, richer note than white wine.
